title: Lei Dang - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Lei Dang in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Lei Dang phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lei Dang is a story encounter in Mirage Estate.

sections.title: Where to Find the Lei Dang
sections.content: Location: Mirage Estate - the region itself rather than a point inside it.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Lei Dang
sections.content:
What works

  • Two phases - the second changes his attack set, so spend phase one learning tells rather than racing the bar.
  • The Tiger Cannon is the reward, and it is worth the two attempts this fight usually takes.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 52 of 60 in the progression order, in Mirage Estate. Before it: Yu Ding, No. 12 Crescent Blade Puppet. After it: Qiu Feng, the Crimson Boneblade (赤骨刀 邱风). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
